# i-am v0.0.5 changelog

- Updated installation workflow: now only the temp directory and `ChangeLog.md` file are created at setup (USER.md initial backup to be handled by future analysis steps)
- Refined setup code and instructions for file and folder management during installation
- No changes to analysis logic or user interaction flow
- Documentation clarified to match actual initialization and backup behavior

- Documentation update only: SKILL.md content revised.
- No code or functional changes to the skill itself.
- The structure and format of instructions remain unchanged.

# i-am Skill v0.0.3 Changelog

- Simplified documentation and removed extra files for minimal setup.
- Consolidated all instructions into a single SKILL.md.
- Removed detailed historical backups and configs; now uses a single `ChangeLog.md` for logs.
- Deleted README.md, README.zh-CN.md, and clawhub.yaml for a leaner repository.
- Clarified file structure and streamlined installation/configuration guide.

- Added skill documentation in English (`README.md`), Chinese (`README.zh-CN.md`), and a ClawHub configuration file (`clawhub.yaml`).
- No changes to core logic or workflows described in SKILL.md.
- This update provides essential setup, usage, and configuration information for better onboarding and multilingual support.

**Major change: Migrated all logic and instructions into SKILL.md for a zero-config, AI-guided workflow with simplified structure.**

- All previous separate scripts, documentation, and data files removed; single all-in-one SKILL.md now contains user/AI instructions and embedded code blocks.
- Added AI-guided interactive installation and mode selection (scheduled/manual), including cron integration instructions.
- File structure greatly simplified: only SKILL.md, minimal config, changelog, and temp folders/files remain.
- Embedded sample Python code in SKILL.md for initial folder creation, user data backup, and conversation data extraction.
- Workflow, trait extraction criteria, and confidence/selection rules fully described in SKILL.md as AI operational guidance.
- Documentation/instructions are now Mandarin Chinese–first; previous English/Chinese README and docs removed.

- Improved documentation with added security and privacy notes on file access, background processes, and data locality.
- SKILL.md is now more concise and beginner-friendly.
- Overview and instructions have a clearer structure; duplications and marketing language reduced.
- Added explicit warnings about local session data privacy.
- No changes to core features or user workflow.

Major update: Gateway-integrated real-time user personality modeling with batch and daily processing.

- Adds real-time monitoring via file watcher; auto-detects and processes user messages for personality trait extraction.
- Introduces batch processing every 10 user messages and daily ACT-R review at 3:00 AM.
- Integrates ACT-R cognitive architecture for inferring user satisfaction from message context.
- No OpenClaw gateway restart or plugin system required—install and enable independently.
- Major code structure update, including new scripts for monitoring, batch processing, and gateway integration.
